user.title: Protocole Alarme
user.description: Runs actions when you arm or disarm your alarm: close a shutter if a window is open, close the garage, turn on a light, start the presence simulator… Rules are then created in the « Protocole Alarme » panel.

data_description.alarme: Rules run when this alarm is armed or disarmed.

abort.already_configured: Protocole Alarme is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Protocole Alarme is already set up.

init.title: Protocole Alarme
init.description:
**[Open the Protocole Alarme rules](/protocole-alarme)**

Rules are managed in this panel. When hidden from the sidebar, it stays reachable through this link, the Protocole Alarme device's "Visit" link or at /protocole-alarme.

data.barre_laterale: Show Protocole Alarme in the sidebar

exporter_regles.name: Export rules
exporter_regles.description: Returns all Protocole Alarme rules (backup, copy). Administrators only.

importer_regles.name: Import rules
importer_regles.description: Adds rules (or replaces all rules). Each rule is checked before saving. Administrators only.

regles.name: Rules
regles.description: List of rules, in the format returned by “Export rules”.

remplacer.name: Replace
remplacer.description: Replaces all existing rules instead of adding to them.

types.name: Rule types
types.description: Rule types from the exported file; missing ones are added.
